reviews.reason: No implemented interface performs an attentive observation and records its completion against a natural object's observable state. Waiting and gathering are not functionally equivalent. Suitable natural targets exist, but visibility and interaction range must be checked at actual use. This capability can record experience without introducing a wellbeing reward.
reviews.specification: Implement versioned public interface observe_nature with JSON schema {type:"object",properties:{target:{type:"string",minLength:1,maxLength:1000}},required:["target"],additionalProperties:false}. Prerequisite: individually complete 1 round of study after implementation. Execution occupies 2 consecutive simulation rounds at the actor's current position, costs 1 energy per active round, and retains normal metabolism without rest recovery. Require energy >=2 and satiety >=4 at initiation; on each active round require positive satiety, sufficient energy, and a still-existing natural plant or geological feature personally visible under existing observation permissions and within the engine's interaction range of its actual geometry. Do not move the actor or bypass solid collision, occlusion, or range rules. Interrupt on movement, incompatible action, lost eligibility, or lost target; retain elapsed time and spent costs but emit no successful completion. Maintain bounded per-actor active state {target,startTick,elapsed} and a completion history using existing bounded event/memory storage. On completion emit one successful nature_observed event containing actor, target, position, start/end ticks and a snapshot of only currently observable target properties; bind the same event to the actor's personal memory and a brief observation-complete presentation with target highlight only while visible. Observation consumes no target stock, alters no object, and grants no information beyond permissions. No new mental satisfaction source, physical comfort modifier, health effect or ongoing benefit is registered; completion alone changes neither wellbeing nor protected scoring. Depend on existing action scheduling, visibility, geometry, energy/metabolism, event validation and memory/rendering adapters. Migrate by registering the interface and event handler, initializing absent active/history state empty, preserving existing identities, stock and validated history, and granting no retroactive events or mastery. Review and implementation advance no simulation time; study and actual execution are separate.
